app_concept: AI-powered developer portfolio builder that turns GitHub repositories into professional portfolios with job-matching optimization
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Developer SaaS)

entry_surfaces./: Hero split — Value proposition and action CTA on left, interactive live animated GitHub-to-Portfolio transformation flow card on right
entry_surfaces./dashboard: Clean SaaS layout — Quick status overview stats header, GitHub connection status banner, mock project cards with tech tags and job match scores
entry_surfaces./auth: Developer-focused centered auth box — Simulated GitHub One-Click Login or Email magic link options

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Linear glowing subtle borders on hover for active project cards
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Backdrop blur 16px with 1px border-white/10 for sticky headers and navigation bar
visual_enhancers.code_editor_look: Dark code preview boxes with terminal control dots (red/yellow/green) for repository breakdown
visual_enhancers.bento_grid: Asymmetric bento grid on Landing page features and Dashboard overview for density and visual polish
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Subtle scale-102 hover states, animated step-by-step AI progress ring, smooth template toggle tabs

instructions_to_main_agent.app_branding: Use 'GitFolio AI' explicitly across navbar, landing page, page titles, footer, and emails/modals.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use pure frontend React local state + localStorage persistence for connected repositories, generated portfolio settings, and template selection.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_toggle: Provide a clean Light/Dark theme toggle in the main navbar and sidebar header that applies 'dark' class to html element.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_flow: Ensure the dashboard starts empty or with an intuitive 'Connect GitHub' button if no projects are imported yet. Clicking 'Connect GitHub' triggers a modal/wizard allowing multi-select from mock repos (Oboeru, Ananka, NewsStream, plus extra sample repos).
instructions_to_main_agent.ai_analysis_experience: The AI analysis loader screen must feature a multi-step simulated progress bar with real-time checkmarks: 'Reading repository metadata', 'Detecting technologies', 'Understanding project architecture', 'Identifying key features', 'Evaluating engineering practices', 'Writing portfolio content'.
instructions_to_main_agent.insights_details: Insights page must show detailed breakdown for 'Oboeru' (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, Hilt, Firebase) including architecture pattern (Clean Architecture / MVVM), engineering strengths, complexity ('Advanced'), and recommended career roles.
instructions_to_main_agent.portfolio_templates: Portfolio Preview must offer 3 switchable templates: Minimal (editorial/clean), Professional (structured/corporate SaaS), Modern (kinetic dark mode / high contrast). Clicking between templates dynamically transforms the rendered portfolio layout instantly.
instructions_to_main_agent.job_match_tool: Job Match page features a textarea to paste job descriptions. Submitting shows simulated 87% match score, pill lists of Strong Matches & Gaps, plus recommended projects to highlight.
instructions_to_main_agent.test_attributes: Add data-testid to every interactive button, input, tab, card, and step indicator (e.g. data-testid='connect-github-btn', data-testid='analyze-projects-btn', data-testid='template-minimal-btn').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie no app-wide text-align: center rule in the CSS entry. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
